title: Resize and thumbnail images

requirements.text: Inputs are checked by their bytes and refused above a pixel limit (decompression bombs) or in unsupported formats
Configured sizes are produced with the aspect ratio preserved (fit or cover) and no upscaling
EXIF orientation is applied, then metadata such as GPS is stripped
Variants are encoded as web formats (WebP, AVIF or JPEG) at a set quality
Variants are generated in a retried background job keyed by source and variant; originals are kept
Variants are served with long-lived cache headers, and on-the-fly resizing is limited to allowlisted sizes or signed URLs

notes: No Genlib image processing. file-signature detects formats from bytes but enforces no pixel limit; durable-jobs could run the variant job.
